summary: Iteration-10 testing: Zadarma number provisioning + Vapi inbound Recepcionista + ElevenLabs library gating + outbound voicemail detection + my-number endpoints. Created /app/backend/tests/test_vozlead_iter10.py (22/22 pass). Verified frontend testids on /app/admin and /app/telefonia and agent-builder.
critical_code_review_comments: phone_numbers.release() calls vapi.delete() with the literal substring check `'None' not in path` — if phone_number_id/credential_id were stored as empty strings (not None), the fallback would try to DELETE '/phone-number/' or '/credential/' with no id. Current code sets None on release but prior shapes could trip it. Low risk, best-effort anyway.

phone_numbers.provision() upserts status='comprando' BEFORE validating `direction` is set — on failure it reverts to 'error' with a Spanish message, which is correct, but the race window briefly exposes 'comprando' to concurrent provision calls. BUSY set includes 'comprando' so a second provision is skipped; good.
zadarma._sign hex-encodes HMAC-SHA1 then base64-encodes that hex string (per Zadarma docs). Confirmed format KEY:base64(hex) in the unit test. Document this in a comment to prevent future refactors.
vapi.build_assistant() uses `metadata.tenant_id` from lead; for inbound the lead is created in assistant_request so metadata is set correctly, confirmed.

voice_preview.eleven_library() swallows HTTP 400 details other than missing_permissions — the admin UI only gets a generic 'ElevenLabs respondió 400'. Consider forwarding ElevenLabs error messages verbatim.

server.py vapi_webhook: for 'end-of-call-report' and other non-assistant-request types the lead is looked up by metadata.lead_id (via S.find_lead_for_call). If Vapi omits metadata (edge case) the webhook silently returns {ok:true}; acceptable but worth logging a warning.

phone_numbers.assistant_request: UNAVAILABLE assistant for inbound without an inbound_agent_id or when quota is exceeded is correctly short-circuited; but note that this still consumes a Vapi assistant-request minute (billed by Vapi). Low-cost but worth noting.

No release of Vapi assistant/phone-number on tenant cancellation path visible from this review — release() does best-effort delete of /phone-number/{id} and /credential/{id}; Zadarma autorenew off is the mechanism to stop monthly charges. Verify billing.mark_paid regression schedules release on 'stopped paying'.
